title: The Tortoise and the Hare
description: “Do you ever get anywhere?” — “Slow and steady wins the race.”
subtitle: By Aesop • A cozy bedtime fable about patience, persistence, and why slow and steady wins the race.

cover.alt: The hare laughing mockingly at the slow tortoise on the meadow path.

blocks.html: A Hare was making fun of the Tortoise one day for being so slow.

🐇 The Hare
“Do you ever get anywhere?” (with a mocking laugh)

blocks.alt: The hare laughs mockingly at the slow tortoise on the meadow path.
blocks.caption: The Hare laughs at the slow Tortoise, asking if he ever gets anywhere.

blocks.html:
🐢 The Tortoise
“Yes, and I get there sooner than you think. I’ll run you a race and prove it.”

blocks.alt: Close-up of the tortoise looking up with quiet determination.
blocks.caption: The Tortoise calmly answers: he will run a race and prove it.

blocks.html: The Hare was much amused at the idea of running a race with the Tortoise, but for the fun of the thing he agreed. So the Fox, who had consented to act as judge, marked the distance and started the runners off.

blocks.alt: The fox judge marks the start line as both racers wait.
blocks.caption: The Fox marks the course and gets the runners ready.

blocks.html: The Fox waved his flag, and the race began! The Hare shot forward like a brown lightning bolt, while the Tortoise set one steady foot in front of the other.

blocks.alt: The hare dashes off in a blur as the tortoise plods forward at the start.
blocks.caption: The race begins: the Hare dashes off while the Tortoise plods steadily.

blocks.html: In no time at all, the Hare was so far ahead that the Tortoise was only a speck on the path behind him. The Hare laughed to himself. This race was already won, he thought.

blocks.alt: The hare looks back laughing with the tiny tortoise far behind on the path.
blocks.caption: Far ahead, the Hare looks back and laughs.

blocks.html: The Hare was soon far out of sight, and to make the Tortoise feel very deeply how ridiculous it was for him to try a race with a Hare, he lay down beside the course to take a nap until the Tortoise should catch up.

blocks.alt: The smug hare lies down in the grass under the oak tree to nap.
blocks.caption: Sure of victory, the Hare lies down beside the course for a nap.

blocks.html: The Hare curled up in the cool grass and was soon fast asleep, dreaming of his easy victory.

blocks.alt: Close-up of the hare sleeping peacefully under the oak, a butterfly nearby.
blocks.caption: The Hare sleeps very peacefully, dreaming of winning.

blocks.html: The Tortoise meanwhile kept going slowly but steadily, and, after a time, passed the place where the Hare was sleeping.

blocks.alt: The tortoise plods past the sleeping hare under the oak tree.
blocks.caption: Slowly but steadily, the Tortoise passes the sleeping Hare.

blocks.html: Step by step, never stopping, never hurrying, the Tortoise kept on toward the flower garland at the finish.

blocks.alt: The tortoise plods on alone toward the flower garland finish.
blocks.caption: Never stopping, the Tortoise keeps on toward the finish.

blocks.html: But the Hare slept on very peacefully; and when at last he did wake up, he opened his eyes wide in shock. The Tortoise was gone!

blocks.alt: The hare jolts awake with wide eyes; the path beside him is empty.
blocks.caption: The Hare wakes with a shock: the Tortoise is gone!

blocks.html: The Hare now ran his swiftest, stretching out in a desperate sprint with dust flying behind him.

blocks.alt: The hare sprints at full speed with dust flying behind him.
blocks.caption: The Hare runs his swiftest in a desperate sprint.

blocks.html: There, just ahead, the flower garland fluttered over the finish line, and the steady Tortoise was almost there.

blocks.alt: The tortoise nears the flower garland finish as the fox watches.
blocks.caption: The steady Tortoise is almost at the flower garland finish.

blocks.html: And then, to the great delight of the Fox, the Tortoise stepped across the finish line. He had won the race!

blocks.alt: The tortoise crosses the finish line as the fox waves the checkered flag.
blocks.caption: The Tortoise crosses the finish line and wins the race!

blocks.html: Moments later the Hare came panting up the path, too late. He could not overtake the Tortoise in time. He stared at the winner, and his long ears drooped.

blocks.alt: The exhausted hare arrives too late as the tortoise waits at the finish.
blocks.caption: Too late! The Hare arrives after the Tortoise has won.

scenes.title: Slow and Steady Wins the Race

blocks.html: Slow and steady wins the race. And from that day on, the Hare never mocked the Tortoise again, and the two became the best of friends.

blocks.alt: The tortoise and hare walk home together as friends at sunset.
blocks.caption: Slow and steady wins the race, and the two become the best of friends.

discussionHtml:
💭 Bedtime Chat

What did the Tortoise teach the Hare about winning?

🐢 Keep Going The Tortoise never stopped, even when the race looked impossible. Keeping at something a little every day can beat rushing and giving up!
🐇 Kindness Over Boasting The Hare lost because he mocked the Tortoise and got lazy. Being kind and doing your best matters more than showing off.
